name: models3d_rig
description: Rig completed `models3d_generate` for animation. provider tripo (default) or meshy — a meshy rig continues with `models3d_animate`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

provider.description: Default tripo. meshy is required before `models3d_animate`.
